g: Weeks 1–6. Know every step with no video and no one to follow. Solo: Hannah's two videos, step by step, copying arms, feet, head and focus at half speed. Apply a teacher's new correction right away. Knees over toes.
Weeks 7–9. Feet, knees, arms, eyes: one fix at a time, and move on once it shows on two videos in a row. Trick preps look like dancing. Thanksgiving week (Nov 23) is light: the memory run only.
Weeks 10–14. Focal points, stamina, costume on: one full-out every session, two back to back on Sundays. 2–3 mini audiences, and tape out the stage size once. Hold every ending.

Week 15. From Dec 28 fewer runs but still one full-out a session, same days. Nothing new, no deep stretching. Night before the show: memory run or picture it only. Sleep 9–12 hours. Show day Fri Jan 8 (most likely)!

Weeks 1–2 of the spring plan. Watch the Showcase video with a grown-up, pick two fixes. Press Play (Jan 15–17) is classes only. Two clean runs on film before Hollywood Connection, nothing new after Jan 19.

Weeks 3–7 of the spring plan. After every comp the judges' recordings come first: listen with a grown-up, write the top fixes on the dance's card, then one fix at a time until it shows on two videos in a row. Ryze and iD are a week apart: ONE fix between them.
Weeks 8–9 of the spring plan. Ryze and iD notes together, two fixes, two clean runs on film, nothing new after Mar 9. Gravit8 is required for PITCH.

Weeks 10–16 of the spring plan. Rest first, then the Gravit8 fixes one at a time, Hannah's videos once more to catch drift, spring break light, then full-outs, a mini audience and the taper into Hollywood Vibe.
Weeks 17–18 of the spring plan. One fix from Hollywood Vibe (or Ms. Brittany's last notes), two clean runs on film, nothing new after May 11.
Weeks 19–21 of the spring plan. The season's list: what every judge said twice is what the panel will see. Both dances clean on film for Ms. Brittany by May 26, then an easy audition week.
Weeks 22–23 of the spring plan. Costume runs, a focal point for every section, the family mini show Thu Jun 17, then one run a day. The whole season on stage.
